title: Pure Dogmatika
summary: Dogmatika cards with generic staples; the page's Mitsurugi alliance is left out. The Dogmatikas summon themselves from the hand once the opponent has an Extra Deck monster out, and their removal sends monsters from both Extra Decks to the GY, so the generic Extra Deck doubles as fodder. The newest cards lead: Lawbringer summons itself and makes each player dump an Extra Deck monster, Fleurdelis, the Thunderbolt Sets a Dogmatika Trap that's live at once, and Quadogmatika Beast dumps a big monster to revive another. Ecclesia searches any Dogmatika card, and Dogmatikamatrix fetches the Rituals.

allow.Alba System Dogmatikalamity: Fallen of Albaz Fusion that sends both Extra Decks to the GY; a Dogmatika-named boss.

main: Dogmatika Lawbringer
Newest support. Summons itself next to an Extra Deck monster and makes each player dump one; sent to the GY, returns a Dogmatika card.
Dogmatika Ecclesia, the Virtuous
Summons itself next to an Extra Deck monster; summoned, searches any Dogmatika card.
Dogmatika Fleurdelis, the Thunderbolt
2025 support. Summons itself on either Main Phase and Sets a Dogmatika Trap, live this turn.
Dogmatika Maximus
Banishes an Extra Deck monster to summon itself; each player sends two from their Extra Deck.
Dogmatika Fleurdelis, the Knighted
Summons itself on either Main Phase and negates a monster.
Dogmatika Adin, the Enlightened
Summons itself next to an Extra Deck monster; destroyed, pulls a Dogmatika from the Deck.
Dogmatika Theo, the Iron Punch
Summons itself next to an Extra Deck monster and shrinks one.
Dogmatika Ashiyan
Summons itself when an Extra Deck monster hits the GY and returns a Dogmatika card.
Fallen of Albaz
Counts as Dogmatika: Fusion Summons using your opponent's monsters.
White Knight of Dogmatika
Level 8 Ritual: dumps from both Extra Decks whenever they activate.
White Relic of Dogmatika
Level 4 Ritual: protects your big Dogmatikas and dumps their Extra Deck monsters.
Dogmatika Alba Zoa
Level 12 Ritual: unaffected by their Extra Deck monsters and makes them shed cards.
Dogmatikamatrix
Searches a Dogmatika Ritual card, then another Dogmatika card.
Dogmatikalamity
Ritual Spell that can pay with an Extra Deck monster of the same Level.
Dogmatikamacabre
Ritual Spell from the hand or GY, banishing Fusions or Synchros as Levels.
Dogmatika Nation
Field Spell: shields Dogmatikas from Extra Deck monster effects.
Dogmatika Punishment
Dumps a bigger Extra Deck monster to destroy one of theirs.
Quadogmatika Beast
2025 support. Dumps a big monster from the Extra Deck or a Dogmatika from the Deck to revive one.
Dogmatika Encounter
Summons a Dogmatika from the hand, or returns one from the GY.
extra: Fallen of Albaz + six monsters in the GY: attacks every monster and can empty both Extra Decks.
